verdict.rationale: OneDrive's Graph API documents a driveItem delta endpoint that tracks changes in a driveItem and its children over time. Graph's delta query mechanism lets apps find created, updated, or deleted items without a full read on every request, which is exactly the incremental-sync story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the cursor/token mechanics (e.g., deltaLink/token handling and resync behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync efficiently — a cursor/delta endpoint returns only what changed since my last call instead of forcing a full re-crawl

citations.quote: Track changes in a driveItem and its children over time.
Delta query, also called change tracking, enables applications to discover newly created, updated, or deleted entities without performing a full read of the target resource with every request.
